frequency_question: How often does the U.S. Education Department complete a full de-recognition or revocation process of a major national accrediting agency within a short calendar window (less than 4 months from notice of final action)?
membership_rule: Includes any formal administrative review, NACIQI recommendation phase, and final secretarial decision resulting in termination or revocation of an institutional or programmatic accreditor's federal recognition. Excludes voluntary relinquishments or renewals without adverse termination.

skeleton: Administrative de-recognition actions across federal oversight bodies typically require formal staff review (6-12 months), NACIQI public hearing and recommendation (3-6 months), and final Secretarial review and decision (2-6 months), totaling a minimum physical process time of 11 to 24 months under standard regulatory processes without emergency shortening.

validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act (APA) timelines and Department of Education institutional review regulations remain stable across multiple presidential administrations.
